# AI Resume Builder

> AI-powered resume analysis and optimization. Upload a resume, get a deterministic score for any of 30+ job roles, and receive AI-improved versions that never invent fake experience.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and getting started.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Create a free account to start analyzing resumes.
- [Log In](/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Optional

- [Privacy](/): Data is private and row-level secured per user.
